## Join us in Norrköping

![](visc.webp){fig-alt="Visualization Center C, Norrköping, Sweden"}

Join us for the second in-person OpenSpace User Meeting in Norrköping, Sweden. OpenSpace users of all levels are invited to the Visualization Center C for three days of trainings, presentations, hands-on sessions, and networking. Participating at the User Meeting is free of charge and is recommended to all current and potential users of OpenSpace of any skill level.

This is a great opportunity to:

  - Sharpen your OpenSpace skills
  - Explore the latest software features and updates
  - Connect with educators, planetarium professionals, researchers, and developers in the OpenSpace community

:::

::: {.content-section-narrow #venue}

## Visualization Center C

<div class="venue-map">
<iframe
  src="https://www.google.com/maps?q=Visualization+Center+C,+Kungsgatan+54,+602+33+Norrk%C3%B6ping,+Sweden&output=embed"
  width="100%" height="360" style="border:0;" allowfullscreen="" loading="lazy"
  referrerpolicy="no-referrer-when-downgrade"
  title="Map showing Visualization Center C in Norrköping"></iframe>

We're excited to welcome you to the [Visualization Center C](https://visualiseringscenter.se/en/) in Norrköping — a digital science center with a state-of-the-art stereoscopic planetarium, driven as a partnership between the Norrköping municipality and Linköping University. This partnership turns the dome into a dual-use space as it is used simultaneously for shows open to the public while at the same time serving as a testbed for the university education.

Norrköping is an old industrial town located about 90 minutes south of Stockholm. Summer is an amazing time for a visit: during the days of the meeting there will be around 14.5 hours of daylight and only 3.5 hours of true night. More information about potential other places to visit during your trip is available on the [Visit Sweden](https://visitsweden.com/) website (or a more humorous take at [Sweden not Switzerland](https://visitsweden.com/sweden-not-switzerland/)).


:::

## Agenda

Schedule is subject to change; this page will always contain the latest information about the meeting schedule. The entire event will take place in rooms located in the [Visualization Center C](https://visualiseringscenter.se/en/).

Unless otherwise specified the locations are:

  - Track 1: **Workshop area, floor 5**
  - Track 2: **VR Arena, floor 1**
  - Track 3: **Eckerberg room, floor 1**

Coffee Breaks are at the restaurant area, on **floor 2**. Coffee will be served at 10.30 and 15.00; the morning coffee will be shorter, the afternoon coffee will have more time to socialize.

## Travel & where to stay

### Getting there

Norrköping is very easy to reach internationally. Some recommended routes:

#### Stockholm Arlanda (ARN)
A major international hub with air service to many European and international destinations. It takes about 2 hours to reach Norrköping from Arlanda by train and the service is fast and reliable. Tickets can be booked through the national railway services [SJ](https://www.sj.se/en?lang=en) and the stations are called "Arlanda Flygplats" and "Norrköping Central". Prices for the train vary, by should be around 400-600 SEK / 40-60€ for a returning trip. If you are staying a few days in Stockholm, its main station is called "Stockholm Central".

### Linköping City Airport (LPI)
A local airport that has direct connections to Amsterdam Schiphol (AMS), one of Europe's main airline hubs. It is also the airfield that houses SAAB, which provides Sweden's fighter aircraft. Transfer to Norrköping takes about 35 minutes in total. The easiest way is to take a taxi to the Linköping central station, which costs about 200 SEK / 20€ and a train ticket from "Linköping Central" to "Norrköping Central" for another 80 SEK / 8€.

### Where to stay

Hotels in the city are around 1000 SEK / 100€ per night. A few options near the visualization center:

  - [Hotel President](https://ligula.se/en/profilhotels/profilhotels-president/)
  - [Elite Grand Hôtel](https://www.elite.se/en/hotels/norrkoping/elite-grand-hotel-norrkoping/)
  - [Hotel Comfort](https://www.strawberry.se/hotell/sverige/norrkoping/comfort-hotel-norrkoping)

::: {.content-section-narrow #faq}

## FAQ

Below are answers to some frequently asked questions about the meeting. If you don't see yours here, reach out via email or on [Slack](/community/slack.qmd).

<details class="faq__item">
<summary class="faq__question">When and where is the meeting?<span class="faq__chevron" aria-hidden="true"></span></summary>
<div class="faq__answer">
<p>August 26–28, 2026 at the Visualization Center C in Norrköping, Sweden.</p>
</div>
</details>

<details class="faq__item">
<summary class="faq__question">Who should attend?<span class="faq__chevron" aria-hidden="true"></span></summary>
<div class="faq__answer">
<p>OpenSpace users of all levels are welcome — educators, planetarium professionals, researchers, and developers looking to sharpen their skills, explore the latest features, and connect with the community.</p>
</div>
</details>

<details class="faq__item">
<summary class="faq__question">How do I register?<span class="faq__chevron" aria-hidden="true"></span></summary>
<div class="faq__answer">
<p><a href="https://visualiseringscenter.se/registration-openspace-user-meeting/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Register online</a> through the Visualization Center C.</p>
</div>
</details>

<details class="faq__item">
<summary class="faq__question">Is there a registration fee?<span class="faq__chevron" aria-hidden="true"></span></summary>
<div class="faq__answer">
<p>No — registration for the 2026 User Meeting is free.</p>
</div>
</details>

<details class="faq__item">
<summary class="faq__question">Is travel support available?<span class="faq__chevron" aria-hidden="true"></span></summary>
<div class="faq__answer">
<p>No travel support or reimbursement is offered for the 2026 meeting.</p>
</div>
</details>

<details class="faq__item">
<summary class="faq__question">What's the best way to get to Norrköping?<span class="faq__chevron" aria-hidden="true"></span></summary>
<div class="faq__answer">
<p>The nearest major hub is Stockholm Arlanda (ARN), about 90 minutes away by train. Linköping City Airport (LPI) also offers a direct connection to Amsterdam Schiphol (AMS).</p>
</div>
</details>

<details class="faq__item">
<summary class="faq__question">Do I need to bring my own laptop?<span class="faq__chevron" aria-hidden="true"></span></summary>
<div class="faq__answer">
<p>We recommend bringing your own OpenSpace-compatible laptop, as loaner devices will be limited.</p>
</div>
</details>

<details class="faq__item">
<summary class="faq__question">Will there be a virtual option?<span class="faq__chevron" aria-hidden="true"></span></summary>
<div class="faq__answer">
<p>There is no virtual attendance option this year, but select sessions will be recorded and posted after the meeting.</p>
</div>
</details>

<details class="faq__item">
<summary class="faq__question">Is there a social event?<span class="faq__chevron" aria-hidden="true"></span></summary>
<div class="faq__answer">
<p>Wednesday evening features a dome movie screening of <em>Once Upon the Moon</em>, followed by a pay-your-own group dinner at <a href="https://hemmahosnorrkoping.se/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Hemma Hos</a>. On Friday evening, there's an optional visit to the <a href="https://www.tekniskamuseet.se/en/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Tekniska Museet</a> in Stockholm. The agenda also builds in extra time throughout the meeting for networking with peers.</p>
</div>
</details>

<details class="faq__item">
<summary class="faq__question">Who do I contact with questions about the meeting?<span class="faq__chevron" aria-hidden="true"></span></summary>
<div class="faq__answer">
<p>Contact <a href="mailto:alexander.bock@liu.se">Alexander Bock</a> or <a href="mailto:support@openspaceproject.com">Support</a> with any questions about the meeting.</p>
</div>
</details>

:::
